0.0: First, let me tell you about the Wild Boars. They typically live in rougher areas than regular pigs. To my knowledge they usually inhabit the areas near Perion. Do note that they are stronger and have large fangs.
0.1: I wonder what connects the two. At least by their looks, boars and pigs don't seem like they have much in common... In any event, are you ready to search?\r\n#r<< You will go into display mode when you accept. >>

yes.0: Now, off to the gorges of Perion!

no.0: Hm, guess you're not ready to go yet. Tell me when you are.

1.0: So, to review... Pigs aren't that strong, but they're trying to get stronger. And those who reach a certain level of strength get to waer the ribbons.
1.1: Those pigs go off to training to get even stronger, and those who haven't adjusted will go into a sort of solitary training in the mountains.
1.2: Pigs who adjust to the mountains naturally begin to look harsher, like Wild Boars, growing fangs.
1.3: This is all very intriguing. An organism can evolve within their lifetime because of environmental changes. Maybe I can become a Horny Mushroom someday...
1.4: I can definitely add this to the book. You can read it in yours once I'm done. Thank you for all your help.
